pokedexEntries.di: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

pokedexEntries.prl: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

pokedexEntries.pt: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a STARAVIA cries noisily.

pokedexEntries.hgss: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
